electric-iris.$description: Electric Iris — Full-bleed section backgrounds, brand atmosphere, sidebar chrome inside the browser mockup — a single high-saturation violet floods entire bands so the page reads as editorial color blocking, not UI state

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Darker accent layer within violet sections, pressed or active states inside the brand color, secondary headings on violet — deepens the iris without shifting hue

oat.$description: Oat — Primary page canvas and hero gradient base — warm cream that reads as paper rather than screen white, the default surface everything else sits on

linen.$description: Linen — Secondary warm surface for cards, nav backgrounds, and footer — a half-step warmer than Oat, used when a layer needs to lift off the canvas without going white

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Pure white for browser-mockup card interiors, text on dark surfaces, and the scalloped divider ridges that separate colored bands

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

granite.$description: Granite — Muted body copy, secondary descriptions, and helper text — mid-gray that recedes against Oat without disappearing

olive-stone.$description: Olive Stone — Subtle secondary text and warm-leaning gray for fine print — slightly olive-shifted to harmonize with the cream canvas instead of fighting it

marlin-soft-sq.$description: Softer variant of Marlin for nav, subheadings, and secondary display sizes (28–40px) — the rounded terminals feel friendly against Marlin's sharper display cuts

marlin.$description: Primary display serif for hero headlines and large editorial pull-quotes at 46px; weight 400 for body 16px — the contrast between hairline serif body and heavy serif display is the site's typographic signature

intervariable.$description: UI text, labels, and interface annotations — the workhorse sans for everything inside the browser mockup and supporting copy around the page

abc-favorit-mono.$description: Micro-labels, tags, and category markers at 12px with wide tracking (up to 0.15em) — the monospaced rhythm breaks the serif/sans pattern and signals 'metadata'

abc-oracle.$description: Secondary serif body at 20–24px for longer descriptive paragraphs that sit between the Marlin display headlines — bridges display and UI without switching families

exposure-var.$description: Tight display headline at 36px with 1.0 line-height — used sparingly for emphasis where a more compressed cut is needed than Marlin provides

apple-system.$description: -apple-system — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
